notes: NOT a Django/web project: ardev-dev/system-Library is a PyQt5 desktop library-management app (index.py + untitled.ui Qt Designer form, MySQL backend). The screenshot is the app's real main window - its own .ui layout, stylesheet and icons - produced by running index.Main unmodified on Qt's offscreen platform and saving QWidget.grab() at 1120x700 with scale factor 2 (script: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ar-MyDocuments-Resume/0bfd9c67-435e-4232-bd64-7ad28abe5767/scratchpad/run/library/shot.py). Because the app hard-codes a local MySQL server, the copy has a small MySQLdb.py shim that maps the same connect/cursor calls onto a local SQLite file whose tables were created from the repo's own peewee models (DB_Structure.py pointed at SQLite, an option the author left commented in that file). Seeded with 12 classic Arabic books (code, title, category, author, publisher, price in riyals), 10 fictional members and 12 loan movements; the 'Total Price 841 ريال' row is computed by the app. Doubts: no native title bar/window frame (widget grab, not a screen capture); the form was designed at 1105x639 and does not stretch, so a ~60px empty dark band sits at the bottom; clipped column headers ('ook Category') are the form's own column widths. Other tabs were rendered too (/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ar-MyDocuments-Resume/0bfd9c67-435e-4232-bd64-7ad28abe5767/scratchpad/run/library/_shot_*.png); the app's 'Today' button actually lands on the Login tab, so Books was chosen.
